# The git-Taffy move, measured before planned

Measured 2026-11-15, on this host, in the trial worktree `target/tmp/trial-taffy-git`, detached at HEAD `0dba5035b`.
The trial has its own target dir. The operator's directive (`inputs#I1`): measure first; if the move cannot be taken
cleanly, stop with the measurement.

## The take as scoped

The 13 upstream commits `1a11761bc` · `4a5ab9cc9` · `510b592ab` · `1e5479ae6` · `b8f4ba6fd` · `9babd796a` ·
`d3ed4e2c7` · `ccfe15332` · `35cdfc859` · `930448918` · `c51dd246c` · `752ed2e49` · `b4952e15f` were taken in that
order as `git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick -n`.

- 13 of 13 applied. The only conflicts were `Cargo.lock` in 12 picks (taken from our side, then re-resolved) and the
  `taffy` rev line of `Cargo.toml` once, at `35cdfc859`. The left-out `0980cce5f` sits between the two revs
  (`e90751fd` → `c2560562`), so the context did not match. That pick's own rev was taken.
- Tree after the picks: `Cargo.toml` (taffy `git = "https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy", rev =
  "a3997d55bacd1fb6cd12fe31db0be15b20f91528"`, the eight features unchanged — `diff` of the stanza against upstream's
  `ea07ee716:Cargo.toml` reads the rev line alone), `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs` (`FloatInsets`,
  `find_content_slot`'s new argument, `place_floated_box`'s caller-defined id — #1303's line),
  `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs` (`cache_get(&self)`), `packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs` (a new
  `pub fn Node::try_layout_data`).

## Cargo.lock

`cargo metadata` without `--locked` re-resolved the lock: `Locking 1 package` · `Adding taffy v0.15.0
(https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy?rev=a3997d55…#a3997d55)`. `git diff --stat Cargo.lock`: 1 file, +2 −3. One
`[[package]]` changes: `taffy` `0.15.1` registry, with its checksum, becomes `0.15.0` from
`git+https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy?rev=a3997d55…#a3997d55…`, and its dependency list is unchanged. No other
package enters, leaves or moves. Git Taffy's own manifest at `a3997d5`: `version = "0.15.0"`, `edition = "2021"`,
`rust-version = "1.85"`, `license = "MIT"`, the same six optional dependencies.

## The legs (`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh {leg}` in the trial)

| leg | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `fast` | 101 (38 s) | `fmt` green; `clippy` red: `error: could not compile \`blitz-dom\` (lib) due to 27 previous errors` |
| `msrv` (`cargo +1.91 build --workspace --locked`) | 101 | the same 27 errors in `blitz-dom` — a type change, not an MSRV limit (Taffy's rust-version 1.85) |
| `audit` | 0 | `advisories ok, licenses ok` |
| `doc` · `build` · `test` · `embolden` · `stand-repeat` · `a11y` | not reached | each compiles `blitz-dom`, which does not compile |
| `wasm` | not run | `examples/wasm_hello`, `seven_guis` and `todomvc` depend on `blitz-dom`, which does not compile on any target. The `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target is also not installed on this host's stable toolchain (`rustup target list --installed`). |

The first `audit`, `doc` and `build` readings of the background run read a `Cargo.toml` with conflict markers (the
`0980cce5f` reading below ran in the same worktree while they ran) and are void. `audit` and `msrv` were re-run on the
restored chain state: the readings above.

HEAD baseline for comparison (`target/ci-logs/test.log` of the fast run on the tree committed as `0dba5035b`, tallied
with ANSI stripped): 239 binaries · 1464 passed · 0 failed · 13 ignored; embolden 6 passed.

## Why it does not build

Taffy #1372 (`c2560562`, "Account for reversed scroll origins via a packed `ScrollableOverflow` type") changed
`Layout::scrollable_overflow_rect` and `LayoutOutput::from_sizes`'s argument from `Rect<f32>` to `ScrollableOverflow`,
whose sides are accessor methods (`git -C ~/.cargo/git/db/taffy-* log -S'pub struct ScrollableOverflow'`). Taffy
`e90751fd` (`ccfe15332`'s pin) does not hold the type. `c2560562` (`0980cce5f`'s pin) and every later pin do.

The 27 errors, by kind: E0615 (a method read as a field) 22 — `right` 8, `bottom` 8, `left` 3, `top` 3; E0308 (expected
`ScrollableOverflow`, found `Rect<f32>`) 5. By file: `layout/mod.rs` 6, `layout/writing_mode.rs` 5, `node/node.rs` 4,
`scrolling.rs` 4, `debug.rs` 4, `layout/replaced.rs` 3, `layout/inline/layout.rs` 1. The readers hit include
`node.rs`'s scroll-offset bounds check (1517–1519) and the scroll extents (2017–2024), `scrolling.rs` and the second
body of the bounds reader in `layout/writing_mode.rs` (266).

Upstream adapts blitz to the type in `0980cce5f` ("Support reversed scroll origins using Taffy's `ScrollableOverflow`
(#1294)", 16 files, +586 −112). `ebacd68bd` fixes a panic that commit introduced. Both stand left out of this tree by
the measured reason of 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-15 (`evidence/lock.md` of those chunks): "needs git Taffy, collides with
the scrolled-box bounds and the hit". `0980cce5f` picked on top of the 13 here: `rc=1`, conflicts in
`packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs` (1 hunk), `layout/writing_mode.rs` (1), `node/node.rs` (2), plus `Cargo.toml` and
`Cargo.lock` (1 each). These are the files of escher's ratified scrolled-box bounds and hit changes
(`physical_unrounded_geometry`, its writing-mode body, `hit_inner`).

## Verdict

The move as scoped cannot be taken cleanly: `blitz-dom` does not compile, under stable or 1.91, on any target, and
no in-scope fix exists. The fix is either upstream's `0980cce5f` (a behaviour change for every document that
collides with escher's ratified bounds and hit changes) or an adaptation escher would write itself across the
scroll, bounds and hit readers (a direct engine change for every document). Neither is the operator's or this
agent's to settle. The forks stand in `.andromeda/runs/2026-11-15T18-29-10-phase/founder-forks.md`.

Registry Taffy: `cargo search taffy` reads `0.15.1` as newest. No release carries #1303.

The trial worktree `target/tmp/trial-taffy-git` is left standing as the record.

# The pin `e90751fd`, measured on the founder's F1 (inputs#I2, inputs#I3)

Measured 2026-11-15, the same trial worktree reset to HEAD `0dba5035b`.

## The take

The 8 commits `1a11761bc` · `4a5ab9cc9` · `510b592ab` · `1e5479ae6` · `b8f4ba6fd` · `9babd796a` · `d3ed4e2c7` ·

  the eight features unchanged.
- `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs` — one line, `crate::taffy_node_id(node_id).into()` as
  `place_floated_box`'s new first argument (#1303).
- `Cargo.lock` — via `cargo metadata`: `Locking 1 package` · `Adding taffy v0.15.0
  (https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy?rev=e90751fd…#e90751fd)`. The one `taffy` package moves from registry `0.15.1`
  (with its checksum) to `git+https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy?rev=e90751fd…#e90751fd…`, its dependency list
  unchanged. No other package enters, leaves or moves.

Git Taffy's manifest at `e90751f`: `version = "0.15.0"`, `edition = "2021"`, `rust-version = "1.71"`,
`license = "MIT"`.

## The legs (`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh {leg}` in the trial, in order, nothing else running in the worktree)

| leg | exit | time | reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fast` | 0 | 456 s | fmt, clippy (with upstream's blitz-dom line), test, ci-scripts (112 tests OK), embolden — green |
